notes.title: Get Stardew Valley plus six more games for less than a tenner in the Sweet Farm Humble Bundle
notes.notes:
Pack your bags, reader, we’re sending you to live a simpler life in one the many farm games Humble are offering in their new Sweet Farm bundle. Okay, so not all of the games involved in the bundle strictly revolve around farms, but the best one does and it completely works with that “simpler life” thing because that’s exactly what the game is about.

That’s right, it’s Stardew Valley! As well as six other vaguely farm/garden/animal-related games that you can get for just $10 (about 7.69).

notes.title: 1.1.3 builds are live
notes.notes:
Hey all, we have just published builds 1.1.3:

- [list]
[*] There's an Undo button! You'll be able to undo your last move, provided it wasn't a move that resulted in a random outcome (example: hitting the grow button, or matching a pattern.)
[*] The game will now save your board progress if you exit.
[*] There is now  a daily mosaic that's unlocked at the end of the first path.
[*] We also added an option to "end the current garden" if you'd like to harvest the gems you've earned so far and move on from the current game.
[/list]

Thanks for your patience, and please let us know what you think!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Five more of one thousand new games on Steam
notes.notes:
Today’s selection marks the 1,000th game I’ve played this year. One sodding thousand. Admittedly it’s a meaningless number but it might give some hope to those of you who are worried that games are going downhill or it’s been a bad year. It really hasn’t.

There are loads and loads of great games out there. Sure, there’s some rubbish too, but this column alone has sifted through a thousand in a mere 8 months, and that’s after discarding the big names, the stuff Fraser or Dominic have poached, the shovelware, and the inevitable daily idiot-milking dreck about PUTIN JONG BITCOIN HA HA HA. And that’s just on Steam!

Things are good, my brave Unknowanauts. Whatever our complaints about Steam? The games, they are good. We are very lucky to be here, now. Long may it continue. Onwards then, to another round of Unknown Pleasures.

Poking the squinty eye of Gary Naysayer this week: capitalist ambitions, parental responsibilities, and racial tensions. (more…)

notes.title: 1.0.1 builds are live
notes.notes:
Hey Evergardeners, we've just published a new build:
 
- Fixed some occasional crash bugs related to using some powerups
- Optimized the game a bit to run smoother, and also added a quality slider to the settings screen
- Fixed some achievement bugs where they weren't unlocking
- Fixed a score exploit

We'll have a big update in a week or two as well! As always, feel free to give us feedback on what you'd like to see, or join our discord chat:
https://discord.gg/flippfly

notes.title: 1.01 builds are live!
notes.notes:
Hey friends, we've just published the 1.01 version of Evergarden. This is a bug-fixing build, with fixes for several stability issues. We've also fixed the achievements that aren't unlocking, and tuned the intro tutorial a bit to make it harder to miss an important feature of the game.

This is just the beginning! We're planning our next steps for the game now, and we'd love to have you in our Discord community, where we regularly hang out and listen to our players:
[url=https://discord.gg/flippfly] Flippfly Discord[/url]
